thread:
Maya (Design): dropping a compact sidebar regroup prototype in Figma — can folks skim? https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/console-nav-refresh
Maya (Design): idea: surface a single parent for Models + Serving, label in UI as 'Deployments', keep internal key = 'workloads'
Maya (Design): also collapse low-traffic admin links into a 'Platform' bucket; show breadcrumbs only on nested routes (hide on root tabs)
Evan (Eng): looks promising. two constraints: preserve existing deep links/bookmarks; prefer path segments over hash fragments for canonical URLs
Priya (PM): agree on 'Deployments' for user-facing label. add a migration telemetry flag so we can map old analytics to new routes
Evan (Eng): plan: keep old routes as short-lived redirects client-side (301-style) and emit a migration event on first redirect
Evan (Eng): sample routes proposed:
```
/console/deployments/models/:modelId
/console/deployments/serving/:deploymentId
/console/platform/settings/:section?
```
Evan (Eng): middleware will set cookie/flag so we only send legacy_event once per user session
Zoe (UX): accessibility notes: keyboard order must remain linear when groups expand/collapse; add a 'Skip to main' link at top of sidebar; ensure breadcrumb links have aria-current="page"
Zoe (UX): also avoid relying on icons alone to indicate hierarchy — needs visible text affordance for screen readers
Maya (Design): good catches. thinking of a small 'Moved from Settings > Models' tooltip on items for first ~10 days post-rollout to reduce confusion
DesignLintBot: color-contrast-warning: --sidebar-compact-bg fails AA for 14px text on hover. recommend +4% contrast on hover/focus tokens
Maya (Design): will file a token tweak and push updated frames; adding admin banner copy: 'Console navigation updated — learn more' (dismissible per-org)
AnalyticsBot: note: map old events to new routes. will accept legacy=true tag on first redirect for reconciliation in Amplitude
Priya (PM): deliverables: figma iteration, color token update, redirect middleware PR, analytics mapping doc, canary rollout runbook, admin comms + FAQ
Evan (Eng): rollout suggestion: feature flag canary at 5% orgs -> monitor click-through, 404 spike, keyboard nav failures -> 25% -> GA
Evan (Eng): I'll open middleware PR + tests for redirects and telemetry; Derek can help with routing infra review
Derek (Eng): on it. will review PR and ensure server-side redirects don't conflict with pre-existing rewrites
Zoe (UX): I'll run a keyboard-only pass on the canary and update the a11y checklist with focus-order smoke tests
Maya (Design): assigning owners in the Figma doc. target canary next Tue unless major blockers. ping me for any UX copy iterations :heart:
Evan (Eng): quick technical note: avoid hash-based deep links — some embeds strip fragments. use path segments so redirects and SEO are simpler
Priya (PM): analytics mapping: old -> new
AnalyticsBot: suggested mapping: ['/console/models' => '/console/deployments/models', '/console/serving' => '/console/deployments/serving'] and emit event track('route.migrate', {from, to, legacy: true}) on first redirect
Maya (Design): thanks everyone — will update Figma and token PR, then drop the checklist in the design doc and ping owners. will also draft the admin banner copy and FAQ
Derek (Eng): PR opened for redirect middleware, includes tests and telemetry hook. tagging Evan for infra review
Evan (Eng): reviewing now. I'll add the canary flag config and the metrics dashboard queries for 404s + keyboard focus counts
Maya (Design): excellent. if no blockers, we start canary next Tue.
